title: Mortgage Application

yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-mortgage-application
  title: Mortgage Application
  description: Mortgage Application contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_mortgage_application_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/mortgage_application
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/mortgage_application

    sourceDigest: ccdc6f89fd750560ab641f8bef7f0b6da14a3729d84719a9d5c8651feddde679
spec:
  role: start
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Mortgage Application
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: loan-term-months
              name: loan_term_months
              label: Loan Term Months
              description: Loan term in months as integer (e.g., 360 for 30-year)
              dataType: integer
              widget: number
            - id: employment-start-date
              name: employment_start_date
              label: Employment Start Date
              description: Start date with employer, format YYYY-MM-DD
              dataType: date
              widget: date
            - id: proposed-hoa-dues
              name: proposed_hoa_dues
              label: Proposed Hoa Dues
              description: Proposed monthly HOA dues as decimal
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: application-date
              name: application_date
              label: Application Date
              description: Application date, format YYYY-MM-DD
              dataType: date
              widget: date
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: mortgage-type
              name: mortgage_type
              label: Mortgage Type
              description: "One of: FixedRate | AdjustableRate | Balloon | InterestOnly | Other"
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: amortization-type
              name: amortization_type
              label: Amortization Type
              description: "One of: Fixed | ARM | Balloon | InterestOnly | Other"
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: occupancy-type
              name: occupancy_type
              label: Occupancy Type
              description: "One of: PrimaryResidence | SecondHome | InvestmentProperty"
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: number-of-units
              name: number_of_units
              label: Number Of Units
              description: Number of units as integer
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: year-built
              name: year_built
              label: Year Built
              description: Four-digit year if present
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: employer-phone
              name: employer_phone
              label: Employer Phone
              description: Employer phone
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: position-title
              name: position_title
              label: Position Title
              description: Job title or position
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: years-on-job
              name: years_on_job
              label: Years On Job
              description: Years at current employer as decimal
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: self-employed
              name: self_employed
              label: Self Employed
              description: Boolean — true if self-employed indicator is checked
              dataType: boolean
              widget: checkbox
            - id: base-monthly-income
              name: base_monthly_income
              label: Base Monthly Income
              description: Base gross monthly income as decimal
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: overtime-monthly-income
              name: overtime_monthly_income
              label: Overtime Monthly Income
              description: Overtime monthly income as decimal (null if none)
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: bonus-monthly-income
              name: bonus_monthly_income
              label: Bonus Monthly Income
              description: Bonus monthly income as decimal (null if none)
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: commission-monthly-income
              name: commission_monthly_income
              label: Commission Monthly Income
              description: Commission monthly income as decimal (null if none)
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: other-monthly-income
              name: other_monthly_income
              label: Other Monthly Income
              description: Other monthly income as decimal (null if none)
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: proposed-principal-interest
              name: proposed_principal_interest
              label: Proposed Principal Interest
              description: Proposed P&I payment as decimal
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: proposed-insurance
              name: proposed_insurance
              label: Proposed Insurance
              description: Proposed monthly hazard insurance as decimal
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: checking-savings-balance
              name: checking_savings_balance
              label: Checking Savings Balance
              description: Combined checking/savings balance as decimal
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: debt-to-income-ratio
              name: debt_to_income_ratio
              label: Debt To Income Ratio
              description: Back-end DTI as decimal percent (e.g., 43.5)
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: housing-expense-ratio
              name: housing_expense_ratio
              label: Housing Expense Ratio
              description: Front-end ratio as decimal percent
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: ltv-percent
              name: ltv_percent
              label: Ltv Percent
              description: Loan-to-value ratio as decimal percent
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: cltv-percent
              name: cltv_percent
              label: Cltv Percent
              description: Combined LTV as decimal percent
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: outstanding-judgments
              name: outstanding_judgments
              label: Outstanding Judgments
              description: Boolean
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: bankruptcy
              name: bankruptcy
              label: Bankruptcy
              description: Boolean
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: foreclosure
              name: foreclosure
              label: Foreclosure
              description: Boolean
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: delinquent-on-debt
              name: delinquent_on_debt
              label: Delinquent On Debt
              description: Boolean
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: intent-to-occupy
              name: intent_to_occupy
              label: Intent To Occupy
              description: Boolean
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: ethnicity-hispanic
              name: ethnicity_hispanic
              label: Ethnicity Hispanic
              description: Boolean — is applicant Hispanic or Latino
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: race-white
              name: race_white
              label: Race White
              description: Boolean
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: race-black
              name: race_black
              label: Race Black
              description: Boolean
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: race-asian
              name: race_asian
              label: Race Asian
              description: Boolean
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: sex-male
              name: sex_male
              label: Sex Male
              description: Boolean
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: sex-female
              name: sex_female
              label: Sex Female
              description: Boolean
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: monitoring-info-not-provided
              name: monitoring_info_not_provided
              label: Monitoring Info Not Provided
              description: Boolean — applicant declined to provide
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: nmls-id
              name: nmls_id
              label: Nmls Id
              description: NMLS ID of loan officer if present
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: financials
          title: Financials
          description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: loan-purpose
              name: loan_purpose
              label: Loan Purpose
              description: "The stated purpose. One of: Purchase | Refinance | CashOutRefinance | Construction |
                ConstructionPermanent | HomeEquity | HELOC | Other"
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: loan-type
              name: loan_type
              label: Loan Type
              description: "One of: Conventional | FHA | VA | USDA | Jumbo | Portfolio | NonQM | Other"
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: loan-amount
              name: loan_amount
              label: Loan Amount
              description: Requested loan amount as decimal (e.g., 450000.00)
              dataType: number
              widget: number
              required: true
            - id: interest-rate-percent
              name: interest_rate_percent
              label: Interest Rate Percent
              description: Note rate as decimal percent (e.g., 6.875)
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: purchase-price
              name: purchase_price
              label: Purchase Price
              description: Purchase price as decimal (for purchase transactions)
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: estimated-value
              name: estimated_value
              label: Estimated Value
              description: Estimated/appraised property value as decimal
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: total-monthly-income
              name: total_monthly_income
              label: Total Monthly Income
              description: Total gross monthly income as decimal
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: present-housing-payment
              name: present_housing_payment
              label: Present Housing Payment
              description: Current monthly housing payment as decimal
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: proposed-taxes
              name: proposed_taxes
              label: Proposed Taxes
              description: Proposed monthly taxes as decimal
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: proposed-total-housing-payment
              name: proposed_total_housing_payment
              label: Proposed Total Housing Payment
              description: Proposed total monthly housing expense as decimal
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: down-payment-amount
              name: down_payment_amount
              label: Down Payment Amount
              description: Down payment amount as decimal
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: down-payment-source
              name: down_payment_source
              label: Down Payment Source
              description: Primary source of down payment
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: total-monthly-debt-payments
              name: total_monthly_debt_payments
              label: Total Monthly Debt Payments
              description: Sum of all monthly debt payments as decimal
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: auto-loan-payment
              name: auto_loan_payment
              label: Auto Loan Payment
              description: Monthly auto loan payment(s) as decimal
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: student-loan-payment
              name: student_loan_payment
              label: Student Loan Payment
              description: Monthly student loan payment(s) as decimal
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: credit-card-payment
              name: credit_card_payment
              label: Credit Card Payment
              description: Monthly credit card minimum payment(s) as decimal
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: other-debt-payments
              name: other_debt_payments
              label: Other Debt Payments
              description: Other monthly debt as decimal
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: borrowed-down-payment
              name: borrowed_down_payment
              label: Borrowed Down Payment
              description: Boolean
              dataType: number
              widget: number
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: borrower-first-name
              name: borrower_first_name
              label: Borrower First Name
              description: Primary borrower first name
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: borrower-middle-name
              name: borrower_middle_name
              label: Borrower Middle Name
              description: Middle name or initial
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: borrower-last-name
              name: borrower_last_name
              label: Borrower Last Name
              description: Primary borrower last name
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: borrower-suffix
              name: borrower_suffix
              label: Borrower Suffix
              description: Name suffix (Jr., Sr., III, etc.)
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: borrower-ssn-masked
              name: borrower_ssn_masked
              label: Borrower Ssn Masked
              description: Last 4 digits only, format XXX-XX-NNNN
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: borrower-dob
              name: borrower_dob
              label: Borrower Dob
              description: Date of birth, format YYYY-MM-DD
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: borrower-marital-status
              name: borrower_marital_status
              label: Borrower Marital Status
              description: "One of: Married | Separated | Unmarried | Unknown"
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: borrower-dependents-count
              name: borrower_dependents_count
              label: Borrower Dependents Count
              description: Number of dependents as integer
              dataType: integer
              widget: number
            - id: borrower-citizenship
              name: borrower_citizenship
              label: Borrower Citizenship
              description: "One of: USCitizen | PermanentResidentAlien | NonPermanentResidentAlien | ForeignNational |
                Other"
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: borrower-phone
              name: borrower_phone
              label: Borrower Phone
              description: Primary phone number
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: borrower-email
              name: borrower_email
              label: Borrower Email
              description: Email address if present
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: coborrower-first-name
              name: coborrower_first_name
              label: Coborrower First Name
              description: Co-borrower first name
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: coborrower-last-name
              name: coborrower_last_name
              label: Coborrower Last Name
              description: Co-borrower last name
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: coborrower-ssn-masked
              name: coborrower_ssn_masked
              label: Coborrower Ssn Masked
              description: Last 4 digits only
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: coborrower-dob
              name: coborrower_dob
              label: Coborrower Dob
              description: Date of birth, format YYYY-MM-DD
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: employer-name
              name: employer_name
              label: Employer Name
              description: Current primary employer name
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: party-to-lawsuit
              name: party_to_lawsuit
              label: Party To Lawsuit
              description: Boolean
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: loan-officer-name
              name: loan_officer_name
              label: Loan Officer Name
              description: Loan officer name if present
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: lender-name
              name: lender_name
              label: Lender Name
              description: Lender / financial institution name
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: property-or-asset
          title: Property Or Asset
          description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: property-street
              name: property_street
              label: Property Street
              description: Street address of subject property
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: property-city
              name: property_city
              label: Property City
              description: City
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: property-state
              name: property_state
              label: Property State
              description: Two-letter state code
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: property-zip
              name: property_zip
              label: Property Zip
              description: ZIP code
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: property-county
              name: property_county
              label: Property County
              description: County name if present
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: property-type
              name: property_type
              label: Property Type
              description: "One of: SingleFamily | Condo | Cooperative | TwoToFourUnit | ManufacturedHome |
                PlannedUnitDevelopment | MixedUse | Multifamily | Other"
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: employer-address
              name: employer_address
              label: Employer Address
              description: Employer street address
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: total-assets
              name: total_assets
              label: Total Assets
              description: Sum of all listed assets as decimal
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: retirement-assets
              name: retirement_assets
              label: Retirement Assets
              description: Retirement account balance as decimal
              dataType: number
              widget: number
        - id: risk-and-compliance
          title: Risk And Compliance
          description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: lien-priority
              name: lien_priority
              label: Lien Priority
              description: "One of: FirstLien | SecondLien | Other"
              dataType: string
              widget: text
  validationRules:
    - id: loan-amount-positive
      severity: error
      description: Loan amount must be present and positive — system invariant; no valid mortgage without a loan amount
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: loan_amount
          - op: gt
            left:
              field: loan_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: loan_amount IS NOT NULL AND loan_amount > 0
      supported: true
    - id: loan-purpose-valid-enum
      severity: error
      description: Loan purpose must be a recognized MISMO/URLA enumeration; invalid values break downstream AUS and
        HMDA routing
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_purpose
            right:
              value: Purchase
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_purpose
            right:
              value: Refinance
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_purpose
            right:
              value: CashOutRefinance
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_purpose
            right:
              value: Construction
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_purpose
            right:
              value: ConstructionPermanent
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_purpose
            right:
              value: HomeEquity
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_purpose
            right:
              value: HELOC
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_purpose
            right:
              value: Other
      sourceExpression: loan_purpose IN ('Purchase', 'Refinance', 'CashOutRefinance', 'Construction',
        'ConstructionPermanent', 'HomeEquity', 'HELOC', 'Other')
      supported: true
    - id: loan-type-valid-enum
      severity: error
      description: Loan type must be a recognized enumeration for investor delivery and compliance routing
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_type
            right:
              value: Conventional
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_type
            right:
              value: FHA
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_type
            right:
              value: VA
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_type
            right:
              value: USDA
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_type
            right:
              value: Jumbo
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_type
            right:
              value: Portfolio
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_type
            right:
              value: NonQM
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: loan_type
            right:
              value: Other
      sourceExpression: loan_type IN ('Conventional', 'FHA', 'VA', 'USDA', 'Jumbo', 'Portfolio', 'NonQM', 'Other')
      supported: true
    - id: borrower-last-name-present
      severity: error
      description: Borrower last name is required — cannot process an application without borrower identity
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: borrower_last_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: borrower_last_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: borrower_last_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(borrower_last_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: ltv-reasonable-range
      severity: warning
      description: LTV > 105% or <= 0 indicates a data extraction error or impossible transaction; route to quarantine
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: ltv_percent
          - op: and
            rules:
              - op: gt
                left:
                  field: ltv_percent
                right:
                  value: 0
              - op: lte
                left:
                  field: ltv_percent
                right:
                  value: 105
      sourceExpression: ltv_percent IS NULL OR (ltv_percent > 0 AND ltv_percent <= 105)
      supported: true
    - id: dti-reasonable-range
      severity: warning
      description: DTI outside 0-100% range is invalid; drop record to quarantine for human review
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: debt_to_income_ratio
          - op: and
            rules:
              - op: gt
                left:
                  field: debt_to_income_ratio
                right:
                  value: 0
              - op: lt
                left:
                  field: debt_to_income_ratio
                right:
                  value: 100
      sourceExpression: debt_to_income_ratio IS NULL OR (debt_to_income_ratio > 0 AND debt_to_income_ratio < 100)
      supported: true
    - id: interest-rate-reasonable
      severity: warning
      description: Interest rate outside 0-30% range is likely an extraction error; route to quarantine
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: interest_rate_percent
          - op: and
            rules:
              - op: gt
                left:
                  field: interest_rate_percent
                right:
                  value: 0
              - op: lt
                left:
                  field: interest_rate_percent
                right:
                  value: 30
      sourceExpression: interest_rate_percent IS NULL OR (interest_rate_percent > 0 AND interest_rate_percent < 30)
      supported: true
    - id: loan-term-standard-values
      severity: warning
      description: Loan term should be a standard product term (e.g., 360 for 30-year); unusual terms flagged for review
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: loan_term_months
          - op: or
            rules:
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: loan_term_months
                right:
                  value: 60
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: loan_term_months
                right:
                  value: 84
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: loan_term_months
                right:
                  value: 120
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: loan_term_months
                right:
                  value: 180
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: loan_term_months
                right:
                  value: 240
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: loan_term_months
                right:
                  value: 300
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: loan_term_months
                right:
                  value: 360
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: loan_term_months
                right:
                  value: 480
      sourceExpression: loan_term_months IS NULL OR loan_term_months IN (60, 84, 120, 180, 240, 300, 360, 480)
      supported: true
    - id: hmda-reportable-fields-present
      severity: warning
      description: HMDA LAR requires state, occupancy type, and loan amount; missing values prevent regulatory reporting
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: property_state
          - op: present
            field: occupancy_type
          - op: present
            field: loan_amount
      sourceExpression: property_state IS NOT NULL AND occupancy_type IS NOT NULL AND loan_amount IS NOT NULL
      supported: true
    - id: purchase-price-for-purchase
      severity: warning
      description: Purchase transactions should have a purchase price; missing value may indicate extraction failure
      rule:
        op: not
        rule:
          op: and
          rules:
            - op: eq
              left:
                field: loan_purpose
              right:
                value: Purchase
            - op: not
              rule:
                op: present
                field: purchase_price
      sourceExpression: NOT (loan_purpose = 'Purchase' AND purchase_price IS NULL)
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      loan_amount:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Loan amount drives HMDA LAR reporting, TRID disclosures, and AUS submission — must be highly accurate
      loan_purpose:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: HMDA requires loan purpose; incorrect routing affects ATR/QM analysis, secondary market delivery
      borrower_last_name:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Borrower identity field — required for OFAC screening, credit pull authorization, legal instrument
      borrower_first_name:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Borrower identity field — required for ECOA adverse action notices and HMDA
      borrower_ssn_masked:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: SSN used for credit pull, IRS verification, CIP — tokenized/masked only; high accuracy required
      debt_to_income_ratio:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: DTI is an HMDA-reportable field and a critical ATR/QM underwriting metric; errors affect eligibility
      ltv_percent:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: LTV drives PMI requirements, LLPA pricing, secondary market eligibility, and HMDA combined LTV
      property_state:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Property state determines HMDA MSA assignment, state compliance rules, and license requirements
      property_zip:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: ZIP code used for census tract assignment (HMDA), flood determination, and property tax estimation

  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-dbrx-instruct
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-claude-sonnet
    maxTokens: 4096
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Mortgage applications are highly structured URLA/Form 1003 documents with standardized field
      positions, checkboxes, and labeled tables. DBRX Instruct handles structured extraction tasks with high
      throughput and low latency, making it cost-effective for high-volume mortgage pipeline processing. The
      field layout is predictable enough that instruction-following models outperform reasoning-heavy models.
      Claude Sonnet is retained as fallback for complex edge cases such as handwritten applications,
      multi-borrower arrangements, or construction-to-permanent loans with non-standard layouts.
